## Measured accuracy (generated by `python -m evals.compliance_eval`)

Sample: 226 labelled messages (26 flagged + 200 random unflagged) out of 2,000. Labelling method and caveats: `evals/compliance/README.md`.

### Labels: strict

- Flagged now: **26 of 26** baseline-flagged messages still flagged; 0 of the 200 random unflagged messages are flagged by the current code.
- **Precision ≈ 38%** (95% CI 19%–58%).
- **Recall ≈ 20%** (95% CI 9%–57%), estimated over all 2,000 messages (≈10 true positives found vs ≈39 missed).
- Naive recall on the labelled set alone: 10/14 = 71%. This is inflated: the set contains every flagged message but only 10% of the unflagged ones.

| Rule | Correct flags / flags (labelled set) |
|---|---|
| CS-CRED | 3/9 |
| CS-DESTROY | 0/1 |
| CS-EXT-CONF | 7/9 |
| CS-PII-KB | 0/9 |

Positives the current code misses (in the labelled set):
- #993 (CS-EXT-CONF): MISSED: quoted 'Privileged & Confidential, Prepared for Counsel' reply to an external consultant
- #1198 (CS-CRED): MISSED: 'login and password for EPMI is <user> <pw>'
- #1224 (CS-EXT-CONF): MISSED: 'please treat this as confidential', external caiso.com recipient hidden by space-joined To/Cc
- #1717 (CS-DESTROY): MISSED: instruction to physically destroy audio tapes older than six months, with litigation mentioned

### Labels: lenient

- Flagged now: **26 of 26** baseline-flagged messages still flagged; 0 of the 200 random unflagged messages are flagged by the current code.
- **Precision ≈ 50%** (95% CI 31%–69%).
- **Recall ≈ 18%** (95% CI 9%–43%), estimated over all 2,000 messages (≈13 true positives found vs ≈59 missed).
